component.name: Hermes Light
component.summary: Desktop client for a Hermes Agent running on another machine

description.p: This is a community package of Hermes Light, maintained independently. Upstream publishes no Linux desktop packages yet, so the pinned AppImage is built from upstream's source at each release tag by the tunix/homebrew-tap repository and repackaged here unmodified — it is not upstream's own build. Packaging problems belong on that repository's tracker, not on upstream's.

Hermes Light is the remote-only desktop client of the Hermes Agent: the Electron shell without the bundled agent runtime. There is no local Python environment, Node toolchain or repository clone — the client talks to a Hermes backend running on another machine (a server, VPS or Raspberry Pi) over the dashboard and gateway API.

ul.li: Point it at your backend on first launch under Settings → Gateways, or start it with the backend address preset: HERMES_DESKTOP_REMOTE_URL=http://host:9119 flatpak run com.nousresearch.hermes-light

Authentication is provisioned on the backend: hermes dashboard register there, then sign in from the client. Beyond a trusted LAN or VPN that goes through Nous Portal OAuth; on a trusted LAN or VPN, plain username and password work.
The agent itself keeps running where it is — this client never starts, stops or manages it.

description.p: The app can minimize to the tray instead of quitting; the tray icon appears only after enabling that in its settings, and it shows on GNOME only with the AppIndicator extension installed.
The app ships no updater of its own on Linux; this package follows the packaging repository's releases automatically, so updating the app is the regular flatpak update.
A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Sound, for notification sounds and UI audio: flatpak override --user --socket=pulseaudio com.nousresearch.hermes-light
Saving files from the client without confirming a folder each time: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-download com.nousresearch.hermes-light

Reading the config of a Hermes agent CLI installed on the same machine (~/.hermes, read-only — the client is remote-first and works without it): flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/.hermes:ro com.nousresearch.hermes-light
Undo all of these: flatpak override --user --reset com.nousresearch.hermes-light
